item.title: Trust the Process Before the Promise
item.description: Let me tell you something that most people don’t want to hear—but everybody needs to understand. You don’t get the promise without the process. We love the outcome. We celebrate the win. We admire the success. But what people don’t talk about is the work God does before He delivers what He promised.

item.title: Let It Fall Apart
item.description: Let me tell you something that will change how you see loss. Sometimes God doesn’t fix things.Sometimes He lets them fall apart. And that’s hard for us to accept, because we keep asking God to repair what He’s trying to replace. We pray for restoration when God is saying, “That version can’t go with you.”

item.title: Discipline Will Carry You When Motivation Leaves
item.description: Let me tell you something straight. Motivation is nice—but it’s unreliable. Motivation shows up when you feel good. Motivation shows up when people are cheering. Motivation shows up when progress is obvious. But discipline? Discipline shows up when none of that is there. There will be days you don’t feel inspired.
